_comment: Client-language wording for PRs that predate the client-log block in the PR template. Keyed by PR number. Fields: title, summary, see, areas, hidden. New PRs should carry the block in their description instead of an entry here.

171.title: Drivers can join with just their licence and details; adding a truck now needs GST; dashboard states that figures are estimates
171.summary: A driver registers with their driving licence, personal details and payout bank account, with no truck. Adding a truck (single or bulk) is refused until a GSTIN is saved in Settings. Trucks already on the platform are unaffected. The fleet dashboard now opens with a notice that every number is modelled from historic trip data and is not exact.
171.see: A new “Driver profile” page for drivers. On Trucks, a notice and disabled Add buttons until a GSTIN is on file. A one-time notice on the Dashboard each session.

170.title: Every dashboard formula audited and locked with tests; utilisation no longer shows 0% for unknowns
170.summary: All KPI calculations (net profit, EMI coverage, per-km costs, driver leaderboard, fuel comparison) were re-derived by hand and pinned by 60 automated checks. Weight and volume utilisation now count only trips where both the load and the truck capacity are known, and show how many trips that is.
170.see: On Utilisation: “Declared on N trips” under Volume and Tonnage, and “—” instead of 0% when unknown.

169.title: Automated checks on every code change fixed
169.summary: The pre-merge check pipeline had been failing silently on every change since a permissions change; it now runs the full test suites on each pull request.
169.see: Nothing visible in the app. Each change is now tested before it merges.

168.title: One unified app replaces the four old front-ends
168.summary: The separate driver, shipper, fleet and ops sites were retired. Everyone signs in to the one BharatTruck app, which shows the surfaces each account has earned. Google Sign-In is enabled on it.
168.see: Old links no longer work; the single app link is the only entry point.

167.title: Security updates to third-party dependencies
167.summary: All critical vulnerability alerts on the codebase were cleared (378 open alerts down to 82, 8 critical down to 0 after the front-end retirement).

166.title: Dashboard “Net profit” is now the true all-in net
166.summary: The headline used to show gross margin under the label Net profit, and tolls and other trip expenses were never subtracted anywhere. Net profit now equals revenue minus running cost minus tolls and other actuals minus EMI and fixed costs. Some trucks flip from “covered” to “short” as a result; that is the corrected reading.
166.see: Dashboard headline reads “after ₹X tolls & other, ₹Y EMI & fixed”; the old figure is labelled Gross margin.

165.title: Encryption key rotated and its committed default removed
165.summary: Bank account numbers are encrypted at rest. The key in use was a default that had been committed to the code; it was rotated and the default removed so it can never be reused.
165.see: Nothing visible. Stored bank details are protected by a fresh, private key.

164.title: Create-account flow fixed: unverified accounts reach the code screen; email failures are reported
164.summary: Signing in with an account that never entered its verification code used to dead-end with a generic error. It now goes straight to the code screen with a resend option. If the verification email cannot be sent, the app says so.
164.see: Sign in → “Enter the code we emailed you” for unverified accounts. Clear error when email delivery fails.

162.title: Verified delivery: driver uploads proof, fleet owner approves
162.summary: At delivery the driver uploads the signed invoice and a geotagged photo of the vehicle. The fleet owner reviews and approves or rejects it from a Deliveries page.
162.see: Drivers: an upload step at delivery. Fleet owners: a “Deliveries” page with approve / reject.

159.title: Fleet console outage fixed and a deploy safeguard added
159.summary: A deploy went out ahead of its database changes and broke the fleet Live view. The changes were applied, the bad revision was routed out, and a gate now blocks any merge that touches the database until those changes are confirmed applied.
159.see: Live Fleet works again. Future deploys cannot repeat this.

157.title: Bulk truck upload from CSV, PDF or a photo of the register
157.summary: A fleet owner can upload their existing truck register as a CSV, a PDF or a scanned image; PDFs and images are read by OCR and each row is added or reported with its error.
157.see: Trucks → “Bulk upload”. Partial success shows which rows failed and why.

156.title: KYC provider seam with a sandbox provider
156.summary: Identity verification is wired behind a provider interface, with a sandbox provider for testing. A real provider can be plugged in without changing the app.
156.see: Nothing visible yet; verification badges light up when a real provider is connected.

155.title: Scan an invoice to fill pickup and drop
155.summary: When posting a load, a photo or PDF of the invoice is read by OCR and the pickup and drop addresses are filled in. Handwritten invoices still need manual entry.
155.see: Post a Load → scan invoice. Addresses pre-filled for printed invoices.

154.title: Drop a pin on the map to get an address
154.summary: Pickup and drop points can be chosen by placing a pin; the address is looked up from the pin.
154.see: Post a Load → address picker → map pin.

153.title: Five-area hardening: analytics trust, geocoding, fleet staff roles, invoice QR scan, KYC seam
153.summary: Analytics figures only count trips with reliable data; addresses are geocoded consistently; a fleet owner can delegate roles to staff (dispatch, bids, documents, assets, analytics) without sharing bank details; freight invoices carry a scannable QR; identity checks sit behind a provider seam.
153.see: Fleet owners: delegated staff access. Invoices: QR code. Cleaner analytics.
